title: Sources for algebraic elimination and further proof theory
details: For later algebraic applications, Marker’s Model Theory II: Quantifier Elimination (2020-10-14), slides 1–13, remains an orientation source; inspect the actual algebraic prerequisites and proofs before adoption. For first-order sequent calculi and proof-theoretic Herbrand extraction, Avigad’s Proof Theory (arXiv 1711.01994v2, 2017-12-16), §2, is a survey that states rather than proves full cut elimination. Obtain a complete source for eigenvariable-preserving cut transformations. Avigad’s Classical and constructive logic (2000-09-19, revised 2001-11-02), §7, states first-order negative-translation clauses but does not supply their full proof. Further source selection is needed for constructive first-order proofs, Heyting arithmetic and natural-deduction normalization.
